verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's own docs describe a "Self-hosted LLM Gateway (Proxy)" with virtual keys, cost tracking and an admin UI, and say every user-deployed proxy serves its own Swagger UI and OpenAPI spec at localhost. A community user independently reports running it in a homelab via the litellm/litellm docker image. missing for 10: first-party installation/deployment guidance (e.g. Docker/Helm setup docs) in the evidence pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Self-hosted LLM Gateway (Proxy) with virtual keys, cost tracking, and an admin UI
A user described running LiteLLM as a proxy in their homelab via the litellm/litellm docker image for local LLM gateway management
the interactive docs exist on any user-deployed proxy
There is no vendor-hosted public spec download; every deployed proxy serves its own.
